tasks.title: Frontend folders and config.js (API URL and mock switch)
tasks.note: Config JavaScript module created with API_BASE_URL and USE_MOCK switch.
tasks.instruction: Create the frontend folder structure with index HTML and config JavaScript. Provide a switch variable named USE MOCK to toggle between local mock data and the live Django backend API.
tasks.request: Open config.js or inspect the window config object in browser
tasks.response: export const CONFIG = { API_BASE_URL: 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1', USE_MOCK: false };

tasks.title: API helper functions in api.js (send requests and receive data)
tasks.note: apiFetch helper implemented with bearer token headers and envelope unwrapping.
tasks.instruction: Write fetch wrapper functions in api JavaScript. Automatically attach the authorization bearer token from browser storage to request headers and unpack the standard backend response envelope.
tasks.response: Returns unpacked response data directly or throws an error object when request fails.

tasks.title: Authentication state and display helpers (auth.js, helpers.js)
tasks.note: auth.js token management and helpers.js NZD currency and NZ date formatters completed.
tasks.instruction: Write helper functions to save the auth token to local storage and retrieve the current user role. Add helper functions to format New Zealand currency and New Zealand dates.
tasks.response: Returns formatted text string NZ$150.00 and the active token string or null.

tasks.title: Sample mock responses for testing screens offline
tasks.note: Offline JSON fixtures created for tours, auth, bookings, departures, and coupons.
tasks.instruction: Copy sample mock JSON files for every endpoint into a mocks folder. Use these offline fixtures when the mock switch is turned on so you can build screens before backend APIs are ready.
tasks.request: apiFetch('/tours/1') with USE MOCK set to true
tasks.response: Returns offline mock tour JSON data without calling the live backend.

tasks.title: Frontend file download handlers (trigger invoice PDF and calendar .ics download)
tasks.note: download.js created for binary blob downloading of PDF invoices and ICS calendars.
tasks.instruction: Write functions to handle binary file downloads. When the customer clicks download invoice or add to calendar fetch the binary blob and trigger a browser file download.
tasks.response: Browser triggers file download for booking 1 invoice PDF or kiwi trails departure calendar ICS.

tasks.title: Register
tasks.note: Customer registration screen created with client-side validation and /auth/register integration.
tasks.instruction: Build the customer registration form with inputs for full name email password and optional phone number. Validate that password has at least eight characters and send data to register.

tasks.title: Login and logout
tasks.note: Customer login screen and logout controls created with token storage and role redirection.
tasks.instruction: Build the login form for email and password. Store the returned token and user profile in local storage and add a logout button that clears storage and redirects to home.

tasks.title: Profile
tasks.note: Customer profile view and edit screen created with /users/me query and update handlers.
tasks.instruction: Build a profile screen showing the logged in user details. Allow customers to edit their full name and phone number and submit changes to the update profile endpoint.

tasks.title: Tour list with filters and paging
tasks.note: Tours catalog built with keyword search, category filter, price sorting, and pagination.
tasks.instruction: Build the public tours catalog page with search input category dropdown price range filters and sorting. Display cards with tour title price image seats left and next departure date.

tasks.title: Tour page (images, guide, FAQs, reviews, departures)
tasks.note: Comprehensive tour details screen created with photo gallery, guide bio, FAQs, and departure dates.
tasks.instruction: Build the detailed tour overview page. Render the gallery of tour pictures guide card accordion FAQs list of recent customer reviews and available departure dates with book buttons.

tasks.title: Departure calendar
tasks.note: Monthly departures availability calendar built with month navigation and departure bookings.
tasks.instruction: Build a calendar grid showing tour departures across days of the selected month. Highlight open departures and let customers click a date to view available tours and book.

tasks.title: Booking form with price quote and coupon
tasks.note: Reservation checkout screen created with live /bookings/quote preview and final booking submit.
tasks.instruction: Build the reservation checkout form. When traveller count or coupon code changes call the quote endpoint to preview price breakdown before submitting the final booking.

tasks.title: My bookings and booking page
tasks.note: Customer booking history screen created with PDF invoice, ICS invite, and cancellation actions.
tasks.instruction: Build a customer bookings list showing status pills reference codes and dates. Provide a detail modal with invoice download calendar invite download and cancel booking button.

tasks.title: Review form
tasks.note: Customer feedback form built with 5-star rating selection and /reviews endpoint submission.
tasks.instruction: Build a modal or page for customers to submit feedback on completed bookings. Provide five star rating selection and an optional comment text box.

tasks.title: Dashboard
tasks.note: Administrator analytics and operational metrics dashboard built with fallback calculations.
tasks.instruction: Build the administrator dashboard displaying summary metric cards for total bookings revenue monthly departures occupancy rate and quick links to review pending requests.

tasks.title: Tours (list, create, edit, archive)
tasks.note: Tour management console built with active/archived filters and status toggles.
tasks.instruction: Build the tour management console. Display all tours including archived ones with buttons to create new tours edit tour content and toggle status between active and archived.

tasks.title: Images and FAQs
tasks.note: Tour editor screen created with full description editing and FAQ creation management.
tasks.instruction: Build photo upload and FAQ management panels for each tour. Allow admins to upload picture files set captions sort orders and add edit or delete tour questions and answers.

tasks.title: Guides and categories
tasks.note: Kaitiaki guides and tour category management interface created with linguistic fluencies.
tasks.instruction: Build interfaces to manage tour guides and categories. Provide forms to create new tour categories and add guides with names bios and spoken languages.

tasks.title: Departures
tasks.note: Departure schedule calendar and capacity manager created with slot scheduling.
tasks.instruction: Build the departures schedule manager. Allow admins to add new departure dates set passenger capacities update booking deadlines and complete or cancel departures.

tasks.title: Bookings and status changes
tasks.note: Admin bookings table created with status filtering and approval/rejection decision buttons.
tasks.instruction: Build the admin bookings table with filters for status date range and customer. Provide buttons to approve or reject pending bookings and view customer special requirements.

tasks.title: Attendance
tasks.note: Departure attendance manifest roster created with interactive present/absent toggles.
tasks.instruction: Build the attendance roster for a specific departure. Show list of passengers with check boxes to mark each customer present or absent on the day of the trip.

tasks.title: Coupons
tasks.note: Promotional discount voucher management screen created with voucher list and creator form.
tasks.instruction: Build the discount voucher management page. Display all coupons with usage counts and expiry dates and provide a form to create percentage or fixed discount coupons.

tasks.title: Reviews
tasks.note: Customer review moderation console created with verified star ratings and feedback display.
tasks.instruction: Build the admin customer review moderation table with filters for tour and rating. Allow staff to view review comments ratings dates and reviewer names.

tasks.title: Sample pictures for tours in media/seed/tours
tasks.note: Thirty landscape pictures provided for all fifteen tours
tasks.instruction: Collect and place thirty high quality landscape photographs into the media seed tours folder with two distinct pictures for each of the fifteen tours.
tasks.request: Save images under media/seed/tours/ matching tour slugs
tasks.response: Thirty image files verified under media/seed/tours/

tasks.title: Guide photos in media/seed/guides
tasks.note: Three portrait photos provided for guides
tasks.instruction: Collect and place three portrait photographs into media seed guides representing the tour guides Hemi Walker Sarah Jenkins and Rangi Bennett.
tasks.response: Three guide portrait photos verified under media/seed/guides/
